user.title: Connect to the Midea cloud
user.description: Sign in with the account you use in the Midea app. A separate account with the dehumidifier shared to it works best. Only hashes of the password are stored, not the password.

appliance.title: Choose a dehumidifier
appliance.description: This account has several dehumidifiers. Choose the one to add; add the others by setting up the integration again.

reauth_confirm.title: Midea login rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The Midea cloud rejected the stored login for {account}, for example because the password changed. Enter the account's current password. Only its hashes are stored.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Midea cloud
error.invalid_auth: The Midea cloud rejected the e-mail or password
error.password_not_ascii: The password can only contain plain letters, digits and symbols (no accents or emoji)
error.no_dehumidifiers: No dehumidifier was found on this account

abort.reauth_successful: The new password works; the dehumidifier is reconnecting

init.title: Midea Dehumidifier options
init.description: Only hashes of the password are stored. Enter the password only after changing it in the Midea app; leave it empty to keep the current login.
